makes.title: What Makes It Shapermint?
makes.body: This wireless shaping bra features modern foam cup technology that delivers the support of an underwire without the dig or discomfort. The wide band construction smooths your sides and back for a seamless silhouette under any top. No-slip adjustable straps stay put all day and keep you lifted without constant readjusting. With convertible strap options and an adjustable hook-and-eye closure, this bra adapts to your body's natural changes

sizeFit.body: True to size. Use our sizing tool to find your perfect fit.

care.title: Care Instructions
care.body: Hand wash cold to preserve the foam cups and shape. Do not bleach. Lay flat to dry. Do not iron. Do not dry clean.

faq.title: All Your Questions, Answered
faq.q1: Will it actually support me without an underwire?
faq.a1: Yes. The modern foam cups and wide band construction give you the lift and hold of a traditional underwire—without the poking, pinching, or end-of-day soreness. Over a million women have already made the switch.
faq.q2: Is it hard to put on?
faq.a2: Not at all. The adjustable hook-and-eye closure lets you ease in comfortably, and the stretchy fabric works with your body instead of against it. No wrestling, no contorting—just clasp and go.
faq.q3: What if it doesn't fit my body now?
faq.a3: Bodies change, and we get that. That's why you can try it risk-free. If you're not completely comfortable, we'll help you exchange for the right size or style—no stress.
faq.q4: Is this going to feel bulky or visible under clothes?
faq.a4: No. The smooth foam cups and seamless band lay flat against your body, so there's no awkward lines or bumps showing through your favorite tops. It's shaped to disappear under anything you wear. Think sleek support, not extra bulk—comfortable enough for all-day wear.
